# Syscalls from C

<!-- GENERATED by sdk/tools/doccheck.py --write-syscalls from sdk/c/include/hzsys.h:
     do not edit; make -C sdk/c check fails when this page and the header differ. -->

`horizon.h` includes `hzsys.h`: 115 syscalls as 117 C functions, listed below
in the order of their numbers. Each entry gives the C prototype as the header has it,
the syscall's number, its name with a link to its section in the assembly reference
(registers, blocks, errors, examples), its `SYS_*` constant and a description. The
brackets at the end give the registers that carry the arguments (A, X, Y, or XY for
a pointer). `out:` names the registers a call leaves in `hz_x` and `hz_y`. How the
functions return and set `hz_errno`, `hz_x` and `hz_y`, the parameter blocks, and
the helpers that are not syscalls: [reference.md](reference.md), "Syscalls from C".

- `void hz_exit(unsigned code);`: $00, [exit](../reference/system.md#00-exit-sys_exit), `SYS_EXIT`. End the task with an exit code. Nothing is flushed: exit() (stdlib.h) flushes the C streams first. [code: A]
- `void hz_yield(void);`: $01, [yield](../reference/system.md#01-yield-sys_yield), `SYS_YIELD`. Give the CPU to the next ready task of the same or higher priority. [no arguments]
- `void hz_sleep(unsigned ms);`: $02, [sleep](../reference/system.md#02-sleep-sys_sleep), `SYS_SLEEP`. Sleep ms milliseconds (10 ms resolution, rounded up; 0 = yield). [ms: A]
- `unsigned hz_getpid(void);`: $03, [getpid](../reference/system.md#03-getpid-sys_getpid), `SYS_GETPID`. The task id (1-62). [no arguments]
- `long hz_uptime(void);`: $04, [uptime](../reference/system.md#04-uptime-sys_uptime), `SYS_UPTIME`. Milliseconds since reset (32 bits). [no arguments]
- `void hz_putc(unsigned c);`: $05, [putc](../reference/system.md#05-putc-sys_putc), `SYS_PUTC`. One character on the kernel console (unbuffered). [c: A]
- `int hz_puts(const char *s);`: $06, [puts](../reference/system.md#06-puts-sys_puts), `SYS_PUTS`. A zero-terminated string on the console, written as one piece. [s: XY]
- `unsigned hz_con_size(void);`: $07, [con_size](../reference/system.md#07-con_size-sys_csize), `SYS_CSIZE`. The console's columns; hz_x = its rows (78 x 29 on the screen; a terminal window's size in a terminal). [no arguments; out: hz_x]
- `int hz_chdir(const char *path);`: $08, [chdir](../reference/files.md#08-chdir-sys_chdir), `SYS_CHDIR`. Change the current directory (inherited by tasks it spawns). [path: XY]
- `int hz_getcwd(char *buf, unsigned size);`: $09, [getcwd](../reference/files.md#09-getcwd-sys_getcwd), `SYS_GETCWD`. The current directory (absolute, zero-terminated) into buf -> its length. EINVAL if buf is too small. [buf: XY, size: A]
- `int hz_restart(unsigned full);`: $0A, [restart](../reference/system.md#0a-restart-sys_restart), `SYS_RESTART`. Restart Horizon (0) or the whole machine (1). Programs should rather use sysreq. [full: A]
- `int hz_sync(unsigned flags);`: $0B, [sync](../reference/system.md#0b-sync-sys_sync), `SYS_SYNC`. Close every open file and flush the card; flags bit 0: end every other program first. [flags: A]
- `int hz_sysreq(unsigned what);`: $0C, [sysreq](../reference/system.md#0c-sysreq-sys_sysreq), `SYS_SYSREQ`. Request a shutdown (SR_SHUTDOWN), a restart (SR_RESTART) or a full restart (SR_FULLRESTART) from the Desktop; (0.31) SR_APPS: the apps changed, and the Desktop reads its Programs menu again. [what: A]
- `long hz_time_get(void);`: $0D, [time_get](../reference/system.md#0d-time_get-sys_tget), `SYS_TGET`. The clock: seconds since 2000-01-01 00:00; hz_y = CLK_NONE / CLK_SAVED / CLK_SET (how it was set). [no arguments; out: hz_y]
- `int hz_time_set(long secs, unsigned state);`: $0E, [time_set](../reference/system.md#0e-time_set-sys_tset), `SYS_TSET`. Set the clock (state CLK_SAVED or CLK_SET). [secs: AX32, state: Y]
- `unsigned hz_vsync(void);`: $0F, [vsync](../reference/games.md#0f-vsync-sys_vsync), `SYS_VSYNC`. Block until the next vertical blank (60 Hz) -> the frame counter. Also blocks until the caller's draw list is done. [no arguments]
- `unsigned hz_bank_alloc(void);`: $10, [bank_alloc](../reference/system.md#10-bank_alloc-sys_balloc), `SYS_BALLOC`. A fresh 64 KB bank owned by the task -> its number. ENOMEM when none is left. [no arguments]
- `int hz_bank_free(unsigned bank);`: $11, [bank_free](../reference/system.md#11-bank_free-sys_bfree), `SYS_BFREE`. Give back a bank from bank_alloc. [bank: A]
- `unsigned hz_mem_info(void);`: $12, [mem_info](../reference/system.md#12-mem_info-sys_minfo), `SYS_MINFO`. Free banks; hz_x = total banks. [no arguments; out: hz_x]
- `int hz_open(const char *path, unsigned mode);`: $20, [open](../reference/files.md#20-open-sys_open), `SYS_OPEN`. Open a file (HZ_O_READ, HZ_O_RDWR, HZ_O_CREATE, HZ_O_APPEND) -> handle (0-3; URLs and connections 4-7). For an HTTP error hz_x = the status. [path: XY, mode: A; out: hz_x]
- `int hz_close(unsigned handle);`: $21, [close](../reference/files.md#21-close-sys_close), `SYS_CLOSE`. Close a handle. [handle: A]
- `int hz_read(hz_io *io);`: $22, [read](../reference/files.md#22-read-sys_read), `SYS_READ`. Read io->len bytes into io->buf -> bytes read (fewer = end of file). [io: XY]
- `int hz_write(const hz_io *io);`: $23, [write](../reference/files.md#23-write-sys_write), `SYS_WRITE`. Write io->len bytes from io->buf -> bytes written. [io: XY]
- `long hz_seek(unsigned handle, unsigned long pos);`: $24, [seek](../reference/files.md#24-seek-sys_seek), `SYS_SEEK`. Move to an absolute position -> the new position. [handle: A, pos: XY32]
- `long hz_stat(hz_statblk *blk);`: $25, [stat](../reference/files.md#25-stat-sys_stat), `SYS_STAT`. Information on blk->path into blk->out (9 bytes: hz_fileinfo) -> the size. For an HTTP error hz_x = the status. [blk: XY; out: hz_x]
- `int hz_readdir(hz_readdirblk *blk);`: $26, [readdir](../reference/files.md#26-readdir-sys_readdir), `SYS_READDIR`. Directory entries of blk->path packed into blk->buf (skipping blk->skip) -> entries read. See hz_dirent. [blk: XY]
- `int hz_delete(const char *path);`: $27, [delete](../reference/files.md#27-delete-sys_delete), `SYS_DELETE`. Delete a file (or an empty folder). [path: XY]
- `int hz_mkdir(const char *path);`: $28, [mkdir](../reference/files.md#28-mkdir-sys_mkdir), `SYS_MKDIR`. Make a folder. [path: XY]
- `int hz_rename(const hz_renameblk *blk);`: $29, [rename](../reference/files.md#29-rename-sys_rename), `SYS_RENAME`. Rename or move a file or folder. [blk: XY]
- `int hz_spawn(const hz_spawnblk *blk);`: $30, [spawn](../reference/system.md#30-spawn-sys_spawn), `SYS_SPAWN`. Start a program -> task id. Returns once it is loaded (load errors come here). [blk: XY]
- `int hz_wait(unsigned task);`: $31, [wait](../reference/system.md#31-wait-sys_wait), `SYS_WAIT`. Block until a child ends -> its exit code (the low 15 bits; see the docs for $FF80 and $FF00+cause). [task: A]
- `int hz_kill(unsigned task);`: $32, [kill](../reference/system.md#32-kill-sys_kill), `SYS_KILL`. End a task (it exits with $FF80). [task: A]
- `int hz_task_info(unsigned slot, hz_taskinfo *rec);`: $33, [task_info](../reference/system.md#33-task_info-sys_tinfo), `SYS_TINFO`. The task in slot 0-15 into rec (id 0 = a free slot). [slot: A, rec: XY]
- `int hz_task_single(void);`: $34, [task_single](../reference/system.md#34-task_single-sys_single), `SYS_SINGLE`. One instance of this program only: when one runs already, -1 with hz_errno ERUNNING and hz_x = its id (the program should exit). [no arguments; out: hz_x]
- `int hz_task_path(char *buf, unsigned size);`: $35, [task_path](../reference/system.md#35-task_path-sys_tpath), `SYS_TPATH`. The absolute path of the file the program was loaded from (zero-terminated) into buf -> its length. A 128-byte buffer always fits; EINVAL if buf is too small. Horizon 0.28 and later (before: ENOSYS). See hz_prog_dir. [buf: XY, size: A]
- `unsigned hz_sys_info(void);`: $36, [sys_info](../reference/system.md#36-sys_info-sys_info), `SYS_INFO`. Horizon's version: major 256 + minor (0x001D = 0.29, 0x001E = 0.30, 0x001F = 0.31); hz_x = the hardware revision (SYS_REV: 0x0C the OPL2, 0x0B sprites, 0x0A Lau, 0x08 the blitter). Horizon 0.29 and later (before: ENOSYS, 0xFFFF). hcc --needs checks a program's needs with it at its start. [no arguments; out: hz_x]
- `int hz_port_create(void);`: $40, [port_create](../reference/system.md#40-port_create-sys_pcreate), `SYS_PCREATE`. A message port owned by the caller -> its number (0-15). [no arguments]
- `int hz_send(unsigned port, const hz_msg *msg);`: $41, [send](../reference/system.md#41-send-sys_send), `SYS_SEND`. Send a 16-byte message (EAGAIN: the queue is full). [port: A, msg: XY]
- `int hz_recv(unsigned port, hz_msg *msg);`: $42, [recv](../reference/system.md#42-recv-sys_recv), `SYS_RECV`. Receive a 16-byte message; blocks unless port | RV_POLL (then EAGAIN when empty). [port: A, msg: XY]
- `int hz_port_close(unsigned port);`: $43, [port_close](../reference/system.md#43-port_close-sys_pclose), `SYS_PCLOSE`. Close an own port. [port: A]
- `int hz_input_claim(void);`: $50, [input_claim](../reference/system.md#50-input_claim-sys_iclaim), `SYS_ICLAIM`. Take the keyboard (EAGAIN if another task holds it). [no arguments]
- `unsigned hz_input_read(void);`: $51, [input_read](../reference/system.md#51-input_read-sys_iread), `SYS_IREAD`. Block until a key or mouse event arrives -> A (key: HID usage; mouse: $0100 | buttons; wheel: $0200); hz_x, hz_y as in ABI.md ("Mouse"). [no arguments; out: hz_x hz_y]
- `int hz_input_release(void);`: $52, [input_release](../reference/system.md#52-input_release-sys_irelease), `SYS_IRELEASE`. Give the keyboard back. [no arguments]
- `int hz_input_lend(unsigned task, unsigned flags);`: $53, [input_lend](../reference/system.md#53-input_lend-sys_ilend), `SYS_ILEND`. Lend the keyboard to a task (flags bit 0: ctrl-C kills it). [task: A, flags: X]
- `unsigned hz_input_poll(void);`: $54, [input_poll](../reference/system.md#54-input_poll-sys_ipoll), `SYS_IPOLL`. As input_read, but EAGAIN at once when nothing is queued (test hz_errno). [no arguments; out: hz_x hz_y]

- `int hz_mouse_inject(unsigned dx, unsigned dy, unsigned wheel, unsigned buttons);`: $5F, [mouse_inject](../reference/system.md#5f-mouse_inject-sys_minject), `SYS_MINJECT`. Test aid: one mouse event through the kernel's path (signed bytes). [dx: A.lo, dy: A.hi, wheel: X.lo, buttons: X.hi]
- `int hz_classic_show(void);`: $60, [classic_show](../reference/classic.md#60-classic_show-sys_classic), `SYS_CLASSIC`. Show the classic Atari until F12 (keyboard holder only). [no arguments]
- `int hz_classic_mount(const char *path, unsigned kind, unsigned slot);`: $61, [classic_mount](../reference/classic.md#61-classic_mount-sys_cmount), `SYS_CMOUNT`. Mount a disk image, executable or cartridge (CK_ ) -> the kind mounted. [path: XY, kind: A.lo, slot: A.hi]
- `int hz_classic_eject(unsigned kind, unsigned slot);`: $62, [classic_eject](../reference/classic.md#62-classic_eject-sys_ceject), `SYS_CEJECT`. Eject (CK_DISK with a slot 0-3, CK_XEX, CK_CART). [kind: A.lo, slot: A.hi]
- `int hz_classic_boot(unsigned mode);`: $63, [classic_boot](../reference/classic.md#63-classic_boot-sys_cboot), `SYS_CBOOT`. Cold boot the classic Atari and show it (0), or only boot it (CB_STAY). [mode: A]

- `int hz_beep(unsigned pitch, unsigned ticks, unsigned volume);`: $65, [beep](../reference/sound.md#65-beep-sys_beep), `SYS_BEEP`. A POKEY tone on channel 1: pitch (AUDF), duration in 10 ms ticks, volume 0-15. [pitch: A, ticks: X, volume: Y]

- `int hz_sample_play(const hz_sample *s);`: $68, [sample_play](../reference/sound.md#68-sample_play-sys_splay), `SYS_SPLAY`. Play a sample on Lau (REV $0A) -> the voice 0-7. ENODEV without Lau. [s: XY]

- `unsigned hz_win_twidth(unsigned font, const char *s);`: $76, [win_twidth](../reference/drawing.md#76-win_twidth-sys_wtwidth), `SYS_WTWIDTH`. The width in pixels of s in a font (0 UI, 1 fixed 8x12). [font: A, s: XY]

- `int hz_spr_set(unsigned count, const hz_sprite *e);`: $93, [spr_set](../reference/games.md#93-spr_set-sys_sprset), `SYS_SPRSET`. Set count sprites (all of their fields) from the next frame on. [count: A, e: XY]
- `int hz_spr_move(unsigned sprite, int x, int y);`: $94, [spr_move](../reference/games.md#94-spr_move-sys_sprmove), `SYS_SPRMOVE`. Move one sprite (the cheap per-frame call). Several at once: hz_spr_move_many. [sprite: A, x: X, y: Y]
- `int hz_spr_move_many(unsigned count, const hz_sprmove *e);`: $94, [spr_move](../reference/games.md#94-spr_move-sys_sprmove), `SYS_SPRMOVE`. (0.24) Move count sprites (1-16) in one call. [count: A, e: XY, A |= $8000]
- `int hz_spr_show(unsigned sprite, unsigned on);`: $95, [spr_show](../reference/games.md#95-spr_show-sys_sprshow), `SYS_SPRSHOW`. Show (1) or hide (0) a sprite. [sprite: A, on: X]
- `int hz_fs_enter(unsigned win, const hz_fsenter *f);`: $96, [fs_enter](../reference/games.md#96-fs_enter-sys_fsenter), `SYS_FSENTER`. Full-screen mode for an own window with the given framebuffer. [win: A, f: XY]
- `int hz_fs_leave(unsigned win);`: $97, [fs_leave](../reference/games.md#97-fs_leave-sys_fsleave), `SYS_FSLEAVE`. Back to the desktop. [win: A]
- `int hz_fs_scroll(const hz_fsscroll *s);`: $98, [fs_scroll](../reference/games.md#98-fs_scroll-sys_fsscroll), `SYS_FSSCROLL`. The full-screen program's scroll registers (REV $0B). [s: XY]
- `int hz_fs_raster(unsigned count, const hz_raster *e);`: $99, [fs_raster](../reference/games.md#99-fs_raster-sys_fsraster), `SYS_FSRASTER`. The raster table: count palette changes at given lines (0: off; REV $09). [count: A, e: XY]
- `int hz_pal_set(unsigned first, unsigned count, const unsigned char *rgb);`: $9A, [pal_set](../reference/games.md#9a-pal_set-sys_palset), `SYS_PALSET`. Set count palette entries from first (count 0 = 256) from red, green, blue bytes. [first: A.lo, count: A.hi, rgb: XY]
- `int hz_pal_alloc(unsigned count, unsigned first);`: $9B, [pal_alloc](../reference/games.md#9b-pal_alloc-sys_palalloc), `SYS_PALALLOC`. count palette entries in a row for the caller -> the first ($FFFF: any place; count 0: give all back). [count: A, first: X]
- `int hz_draw_list(unsigned win, unsigned count, const hz_drawrec *r);`: $9C, [draw_list](../reference/games.md#9c-draw_list-sys_drawlist), `SYS_DRAWLIST`. Run count (1-128) draw-list records with the blitter -> records drawn. Returns at once: see list_wait. [win: A.lo, count: A.hi, r: XY]
- `unsigned hz_list_wait(unsigned ask);`: $9D, [list_wait](../reference/games.md#9d-list_wait-sys_listwait), `SYS_LISTWAIT`. 0: block until the caller's draw list is done; 1: poll -> 1 while it runs. [ask: A]
- `unsigned hz_frame(void);`: $9E, [frame](../reference/games.md#9e-frame-sys_frame), `SYS_FRAME`. The frame counter (+1 every vertical blank; REV $09). [no arguments]
- `int hz_win_vbl(unsigned win, unsigned on);`: $9F, [win_vbl](../reference/games.md#9f-win_vbl-sys_winvbl), `SYS_WINVBL`. WE_VBL events at every vertical blank (REV $09). [win: A, on: X]
- `int hz_win_front(unsigned win);`: $A0, [win_front](../reference/windows.md#a0-win_front-sys_wfront), `SYS_WFRONT`. Raise an own window (restored if minimized) and give it the focus. [win: A]
- `int hz_sheet_new(const hz_sheetnew *s);`: $A1, [sheet_new](../reference/games.md#a1-sheet_new-sys_sheetnew), `SYS_SHEETNEW`. Register a sheet of art in own memory -> its number (1-32). [s: XY]
- `int hz_sheet_free(unsigned sheet);`: $A2, [sheet_free](../reference/games.md#a2-sheet_free-sys_sheetfree), `SYS_SHEETFREE`. Free a sheet ($FFFF: all of the caller's). [sheet: A]
- `int hz_sheet_draw(unsigned win, unsigned count, const hz_sheetrec *r);`: $A3, [sheet_draw](../reference/games.md#a3-sheet_draw-sys_sheetdraw), `SYS_SHEETDRAW`. Run count (1-128) sheet records -> records drawn. Returns at once: see list_wait. [win: A.lo, count: A.hi, r: XY]
- `int hz_fill_runs(unsigned count, const hz_fillruns *b);`: $A4, [fill_runs](../reference/games.md#a4-fill_runs-sys_fillruns), `SYS_FILLRUNS`. (0.30) Fill count (0-2688) runs {offset, colour, width} (or, with FR_GROUPS, groups of runs in the program's own layout) into a page of own memory with the blitter -> count. Returns at once (see list_wait). EINVAL: hz_x = the index of a run (group) past the page. ENODEV before REV $09 or with the blitter off: fill them with the CPU (hgame's hg_fill_runs does). [count: A, b: XY; out: hz_x]
- `long hz_uptime_us(void);`: $A5, [uptime_us](../reference/games.md#a5-uptime_us-sys_uptimeus), `SYS_UPTIMEUS`. (0.30) Microseconds since reset (32 bits; wraps after 71.6 minutes). [no arguments]
